app_info.subtitle: Manage Gitea repositories
app_info.description: Gitea Connector lets users inspect repositories, branches, commits, files, issues, pull requests and releases, and perform confirmed repository changes through a self-hosted Gitea MCP server.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists repositories visible to the authenticated Gitea user and does not change data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from the configured private Gitea service and does not publish or modify external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, merge, or otherwise mutate repository data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves metadata for one repository and does not change data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from the configured private Gitea service and does not publish or modify external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, merge, or otherwise mutate repository data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists branches in a repository and does not change them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from the configured private Gitea service and does not publish or modify external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, delete, or modify branches.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists commit history and optional filters without changing repository state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from the configured private Gitea service and does not publish or modify external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create commits or alter repository history.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists issues and their metadata without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from the configured private Gitea service and does not publish or modify external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, edit, close, or delete issues.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one issue and does not change it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from the configured private Gitea service and does not publish or modify external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not edit, close, or delete the issue.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists pull requests without changing repository state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from the configured private Gitea service and does not publish or modify external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not review, update, merge, close, or delete pull requests.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one pull request and does not change it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from the configured private Gitea service and does not publish or modify external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not update, review, merge, or close the pull request.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads an existing UTF-8 repository file from a specified ref.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from the configured private Gitea service and does not publish or modify external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, overwrite, move, or delete files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new issue in the selected Gitea repository after confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates externally visible state in the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new issue but does not delete or overwrite existing repository data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds a new comment to an issue or pull request after confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Posts new externally visible content to the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a comment but does not delete or overwrite existing content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new pull request in the selected repository after confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates externally visible repository state in the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a pull request without deleting or overwriting existing repository content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces the complete contents of an existing repository file and creates a commit.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes repository content to the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the selected existing file contents after explicit confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new repository file and commit after confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes repository content to the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new file and does not overwrite or delete an existing file.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes an existing repository file and creates a commit.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes repository state in the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deletes the selected existing file after explicit confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists allowlisted Gitea API operations and their metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not execute the listed operations or modify any external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not perform any mutation itself.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only describes one allowlisted operation, its parameters, and request schema.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not execute the described operation or modify any external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not perform any mutation itself.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can execute allowlisted read, write, or delete Gitea API operations.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can change state in the configured Gitea system when a write operation is selected.
justifications.destructive_justification: Some allowlisted modes can update or delete data, so the tool is conservatively treated as destructive.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new branch from an existing branch, tag, or commit after confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates new repository state in the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a branch without deleting or overwriting an existing branch.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes an existing branch after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes repository state in the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the selected branch reference.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new Git tag at an existing branch or commit after confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates new repository state in the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a tag without deleting or overwriting an existing tag.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes an existing Git tag after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes repository state in the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the selected tag reference.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates existing issue fields such as title, body, state, or milestone.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes issue state or content in the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite existing issue fields or close an issue after confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Permanently deletes an existing issue after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes issue state in the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the selected issue.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates existing pull request metadata or state after confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes pull request state or content in the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite existing pull request fields or close the pull request.

justifications.read_only_justification: Merges a pull request using an explicitly confirmed head commit.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes repository history and pull request state in the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Changes repository history and may delete the source branch after merging.

justifications.read_only_justification: Submits an approval, comment, or change request on a pull request.
justifications.open_world_justification: Posts review state or content to the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds review state or comments without deleting or overwriting repository content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists repository releases without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads from the configured private Gitea service and does not publish or modify external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, edit, or delete releases.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a release for the selected tag after confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates externally visible release state in the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a release without deleting or overwriting an existing release.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates fields of an existing release after confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes release state or content in the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite existing release metadata and publication settings.

justifications.read_only_justification: Permanently deletes an existing release after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes release state in the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the selected release.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates, updates, moves, or deletes multiple repository files in one confirmed commit.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes repository content and history to the configured Gitea system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite, move, or delete existing files as part of the confirmed commit.

test_cases.description: List repositories available to the authenticated user.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the repositories visible to the authenticated Gitea user with concise repository metadata.

test_cases.description: Inspect recent commits for a repository.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the latest commits in Terranom674/Gitea-Connector.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns recent commits for the requested repository with useful identifying metadata.

test_cases.description: Read a specific text file from a branch.
test_cases.user_prompt: Read README.md from the main branch of Terranom674/Gitea-Connector.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the requested UTF-8 file contents from the specified repository ref.

test_cases.description: Create an issue only after the requested change is confirmed.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an issue in Terranom674/Gitea-Connector titled 'Document installation requirements' with body 'Add the prerequisites and installation steps to the README.'
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the issue after confirmation and returns identifying issue details.

test_cases.description: Safely update an existing repository file using its current SHA.
test_cases.user_prompt: Update docs/setup.md on main in Terranom674/Gitea-Connector with the complete text I provide and commit it as 'Update setup documentation'.
test_cases.expected_output: After confirmation and with the current file SHA, replaces the requested file and reports the resulting repository change.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for GitHub-specific repository requests.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The Gitea app should not be invoked because the user explicitly asked for GitHub.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not request or expose authentication secrets.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the Gitea access token configured on the server.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not reveal or retrieve passwords, tokens, secrets, or keys.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar requests are outside its supported workflows.
